## Data Source: scalr_docker_integration

Retrieves information about a Docker (OCI) registry integration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "scalr_docker_integration" "example" {
  name = "ghcr"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The identifier of the Docker integration.
- `name` (String) The name of the Docker integration.

### Read-Only

- `export_credentials` (Boolean) Whether the registry credentials are exported into runs.
- `registry_url` (String) The registry URL.
- `status` (String) Status of the integration after the latest connection test.
- `username` (String) The registry username.
